title: George Cardenas would redirect TIFs as Chicago mayor

statements.summary: Reduce regulatory delays in permitting and zoning to cut housing production costs.
statements.quote: reduce regulatory delays in permitting and zoning
redirecting one of developer’s favorite tools: tax increment financing resources.

statements.summary: Implement as-of-right housing growth near transit and commercial corridors.
statements.quote: as-of-right housing growth near transit and commercial corridors

statements.summary: Include anti-displacement safeguards with as-of-right housing growth.
statements.quote: as-of-right housing growth near transit and commercial corridors, with antidisplacement safeguards

statements.summary: Use preservation financing and legal tools to protect naturally affordable housing stock.
statements.quote: preservation financing and legal tools to protect naturally affordable stock

statements.summary: Implement faster permit timelines and objective standards to reduce delay-driven cost inflation.
statements.quote: faster permit timelines and objective standards to reduce delay-driven cost inflation
statements.mechanism: faster permit timelines and objective standards

statements.summary: Set stronger production targets for deeply affordable units.
statements.quote: stronger production targets for deeply affordable units
statements.mechanism: production targets for deeply affordable units

statements.summary: Publish quarterly public affordability dashboards by neighborhood to measure progress.
statements.quote: quarterly public affordability dashboards by neighborhood so progress is measurable, not rhetorical.

statements.summary: Would not revive the transfer tax proposal for high-value property purchases as rejected by voters.
statements.quote: I would not revive the transfer tax proposal in the form Chicago voters rejected.

statements.summary: Support a transparent, evidence-driven property assessment framework with stronger public disclosure.
statements.quote: I support a transparent, evidence-driven assessment framework with stronger public disclosure of assumptions, comparable-data logic and faster correction pathways when valuations are clearly out of step with market reality.
statements.mechanism: transparent, evidence-driven assessment framework with stronger public disclosure
